0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers come into this road game 2-0 and half a game behind for second in the Northwest and fourth in the West, while the Lakers are 3-0, first in the Pacific and first in the West. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (out, ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Scoot Henderson (ankle soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Trail Blazers won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026.
